actions.action: Preserve arrival order across every reroute
actions.mechanism: A permanent arrival timestamp gives each case its original place among cases competing for an eligible worker.
actions.implementation: Make arrived_at immutable; retain it across tag changes. Select oldest eligible cases using a stable intake sequence to break simultaneous-arrival ties.
actions.check: Submit simultaneous arrivals, then correct wrong tags repeatedly; verify timestamps remain unchanged and older eligible cases precede newer ones.
actions.risk: Fairness applies among eligible cases, not a single global queue.

actions.action: Gate assignments against qualifications and shift capacity
actions.mechanism: Assignment requires matching language, product expertise, urgent qualification when applicable, and available roster capacity.
actions.implementation: Revalidate eligibility and reserve capacity atomically at assignment. Determine urgency from documented case-impact criteria, never customer status or spending.
actions.check: Test concurrent assignments and shift changes. With neither trained urgent worker available, urgent cases remain unassigned and trigger coverage escalation.
actions.risk: Stale roster data can invalidate otherwise correct eligibility checks.

actions.action: Expose separate skill and information blockers
actions.mechanism: Independent blocker flags distinguish staffing shortages from missing customer details, including cases blocked by both.
actions.implementation: Display missing skills, required information, blocker owner, and next review time. Clear flags independently; preserve arrival order when information arrives.
actions.check: Create skill-only, information-only, and dual-blocked cases; verify distinct displays and that clearing information never bypasses qualification checks.
actions.risk: Overbroad information requirements can unnecessarily delay service.

actions.action: Run bounded reviews of suspected wrong tags
actions.mechanism: Small, monitored correction batches can release misrouted cases without overwhelming newly eligible staff.
actions.implementation: Review five oldest suspected mistags when rostered review capacity exists. Preserve originals and audit corrections; pause if destination backlog exceeds a preset threshold.
actions.check: Seed wrong tags; verify corrections retain arrival priority and qualification gates. With no review capacity, retain cases for individual review.
actions.risk: Backlog thresholds must pause batch review, not ordinary case routing.
